Customer: SignalFlux TicketWorks — mid-size e-commerce platform doing high-volume B2C orders. Primary ask: agent assist + automated tool-calls to internal support systems (Zendesk-like ticket system and proprietary order API). Need: create/update tickets, push refund requests, tag for escalations; synchronous tool-calls from agent UI and async callbacks for automation.

Key constraints/requirements:
- Peak traffic spikes during promotions: must sustain 8k concurrent sessions; degrade gracefully (fallback to cached summaries) when capacity constrained.
- Tool-calling guarantees: at-least-once with deduplication; idempotent endpoints; audit trail / traceability for every API call (request IDs, user IDs).
- Latency SLO: interactive agent assist <120ms median for suggested actions; ticket creation acceptable up to 600ms end-to-end including downstream API.
- Security: full SSO (SAML), SOC2 compliance, KMS-managed keys for any stored PII, audit logs retained 2 years, optional data residency in us-east.
- Integration targets: internal ticketing (REST), payments/refund API (POST /refunds), escalation webhooks to Ops Slack/PagerDuty.

Quotes from call: "We cannot have duplicate refunds; idempotency is non-negotiable." — Head of Ops.
